status: Source-backed implementation specification; no swap-level filter executed by this artifact
purpose: Separate data-valid completed activity from behavioral risk flags without presenting automation or arbitrage as proven wash trading.

availableSourceGrain.existingDuneMetrics: dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics is day/source/token aggregate data. It cannot identify completed user swaps, opposing counterparties, solver identities, circular transactions or wash-trading intent.
availableSourceGrain.documentedExplorer: Read-only 1Click transaction records. Partner JWT required; documented rate is one request per five seconds; cursor uses depositAddress and depositMemo. This is not an all-Intents census.
documentedAbsentFields: actual swap completion timestamp in documented Explorer response
availableSourceGrain.warning: A documented field is a schema capability, not proof that it is populated, externally accessible with current credentials, or suitable for every historical/confidential record.

sources.contribution: Read-only 1Click scope, partner authentication and rate limit.
Transaction schema and cursor; no documented solver identifier or completion timestamp.
Verifier execution accepts ordered lists; asynchronous cross-contract completion cannot be inferred from submission order.
Signed-account authority and relay/market-maker settlement; submitter identity is not automatically a solver operator.

Controlled-wallet evidence distinguishes inventory recycling from one-sided issuer disposal. Balanced flow alone misses other manipulation forms; enforcement-grounded ownership is stronger evidence than a pattern.
sources.transferLimit: Evidence from documented enforcement cases does not validate NEAR-specific thresholds or identify its wallets.

sources.contribution: Transaction-count, volume and return complexity can expose unusual patterns; the authors explicitly distinguish anomaly evidence from direct proof of wash trading.
sources.transferLimit: CEX high-frequency statistics are diagnostic context, not an event-removal classifier for NEAR cross-chain settlement.

sources.type: primary research abstract inspected; full large PDF not fetched
sources.contribution: Approximately closed counterparty clusters motivate graph diagnostics, with automated market-making explicitly a detection challenge.
sources.transferLimit: No production implementation or parameters copied; underlying full paper and NEAR adaptation remain unvalidated.

canonicalTradeRequirements.grain: One completed user order, not each token leg, signed payload, receipt, deposit, withdrawal or solver hedge.
canonicalTradeRequirements.candidateOrderKey: Provider namespace plus depositAddress plus explicit depositMemo null sentinel, after proving uniqueness and update semantics; use a stronger documented immutable order ID if the source provides it.
canonicalTradeRequirements.deduplication: Exact duplicate records collapse only if payloads agree. Conflicting versions require a source timestamp/version or refetch; quarantine unresolved conflicts rather than selecting arbitrarily.
canonicalTradeRequirements.accountIdentity: Use chain-qualified addresses with chain-specific normalization. Never lowercase case-sensitive addresses or infer common control solely from equal strings on unrelated chains. Preserve multi-sender ambiguity.
canonicalTradeRequirements.pairIdentity: Resolve originAsset and destinationAsset against a versioned official token registry; retain exact chain and representation plus optional canonical economic asset mapping. Unknown mappings remain Unknown.
canonicalTradeRequirements.notional: One-sided input USD for completed user orders with finite strictly positive observed input USD. Do not add input and output values or translate missing prices to zero. Report priced-order/count coverage.
canonicalTradeRequirements.time: Use actual verified settlement/completion time for temporal behavior. Explorer createdAt may be used only in explicitly creation-time diagnostics, not called execution latency or completion order.
canonicalTradeRequirements.privacy: Confidential or unavailable participant fields stay unassessable. Do not call unassessable activity unflagged or organic.

reasonCodePrecedence.criterion: Missing canonical order key or unresolved key collision.
Same validated order key and identical economic payload; retain provenance and duplicate count.
Same key with conflicting status or amounts without authoritative version resolution.
Provider status not confirmed completed; retain pending/failed/refunded counts separately. SUCCESS mapping must be verified against source semantics.
Null/nonfinite/nonpositive input USD; retain otherwise valid order count and token quantities.

reasonCodePrecedence.action: retain total but exclude named-route cohort
reasonCodePrecedence.criterion: Unresolved source/destination token or chain mapping; publish Unknown bucket.
An explicit, versioned, externally supported test-wallet/order label; no inference from low amounts.

reasonCodePrecedence.action: retain reported volume; mark behavioral coverage unknown
reasonCodePrecedence.criterion: No validated customer account identity, multi-sender ambiguity, or confidentiality prevents sequence reconstruction.

Same resolved customer entity completes reverse exact economic asset route within configured interval; returned initial-asset quantity approximately equals original quantity. Cross-chain same-asset bridge alone is never sufficient.
Same assessable customer and route has at least configured count of orders per hour, highly similar sizes and regular interarrival times.

reasonCodePrecedence.action: flag-only, not enabled until counterparty ownership supported
reasonCodePrecedence.criterion: Verified trade counterparties form high-internal-flow, near-inventory-neutral clusters. Never construct this graph from shared deposit/bridge/relayer infrastructure.

reasonCodePrecedence.action: exclude from explicitly common-control-adjusted view only
reasonCodePrecedence.criterion: Verified opposing economic counterparties share proven control and no meaningful exposure transfer. A common relayer, originating account, recipient or solver registry label alone does not meet this standard.

behavioralDefaults.calibrationStatus: Researcher-selected transparent diagnostics; not estimates trained or validated on labeled NEAR wash trades. No default organic-volume claim.

circularSequence.matching: Deterministic one-to-one chronological matching on verified completion time; no order can be matched twice. All constituent order IDs retained. If completion time absent, this rule is not enabled for wash-adjusted published totals.

repetitiveExecution.interpretation: Automation-shaped execution, not bot identity or abuse. Do not remove legitimate solvers, arbitrage or agent transactions solely for this flag.

closedCluster.requirements: Economic counterparty graph, asset-level inventory flows and independent ownership/identity evidence. Current aggregate Dune data cannot supply these.

accounting.exclusiveBuckets: Each canonical valid completed priced order enters exactly one primary bucket: behaviorally unassessable, assessable unflagged, flagged-only, or verified common-control/test exclusion. Secondary flags may overlap but primary volumes never double-count.
accounting.sensitivityIdentity: heuristic_retained_usd(parameters) = reported_completed_priced_usd - verified_excluded_usd - distinct_candidate_order_usd(parameters); candidates cannot include already excluded orders
accounting.unassessableHandling: Unassessable volume remains in reported and retained figures with coverage disclosed. No behavioral inference for this cohort.
accounting.feeRule: Calculate filtered fees per USD only from actual fees attributed to the same retained orders and currency basis. Do not divide aggregate all-protocol fees by a filtered 1Click-only denominator or allocate fees pro rata without an explicit modeled label.
accounting.botRule: No blanket bot-adjusted headline. User-facing options distinguish reported completed, data-valid priced, common-control-adjusted (when established) and circular-pattern sensitivity.
accounting.unitRule: Fees per $1M = 1,000,000 * sum(matched retained fees USD) / sum(matched retained input notional USD). Null when denominator or aligned fee coverage unavailable; ratio of sums, not mean of per-order ratios.

falsePositiveRisks: Market makers and solvers deliberately cycle inventory while providing real liquidity.
Arbitrage and treasury rebalancing produce reverse routes and near-zero net inventory.
Dollar-cost averaging and integrations produce repeated sizes and regular timing.
Cross-chain self-transfers are a core bridge use case, not self-trading proof.
A shared exchange deposit, router, relayer, bridge or fee recipient does not establish common beneficial ownership.
Customer identity can be hidden by confidential flows or custodial aggregation; raw submitters can aggregate many users.
Input/output USD differences include slippage, gas, asset movement and fees; they are not a clean fee estimate.
requiredValidation: Verify provider key uniqueness, status mapping, revisions and full cursor traversal on real authorized records.
Reconcile one-sided order notional against source-reported totals for the same 1Click scope, time cutoff and price methodology; explain residuals rather than force a match to all-Intents aggregates.

Test exact duplicates, conflicting revisions, multi-sender records, missing prices, failed/refunded orders, same-address bridge, legitimate reverse arbitrage, repeated legitimate solver fills, timestamp ties and missing participant identities.
Check exclusive volume/fee identities and filter overlap under every published parameter setting.
Publish assessed count/USD coverage, unknown routes, unpriced count, lookback boundary buffer and source lag with every result.
Manually review stratified flagged and unflagged samples before enabling any behavioral-adjusted headline. Without labeled cases, no accuracy, recall or true organic-volume claim.
Do not publish private wallet-level partner records or credentials; verify source redistribution permission and prefer aggregate outputs.

publicImplementation.verified: Synthetic invariants and eight observed saved Dune public token_diff records parse successfully. Input adapter asserts query contract scope, numeric log index and UTC timestamp.
publicImplementation.grain: Public account-side token_diff event, not user swap
publicImplementation.rules: Physical-key conflicts quarantine; agreeing ingestion duplicates collapse; exact successful dip4 token_diff only; signed i128 amounts retain BigInt precision; exact-two-asset reverse-account pattern is flag-only.
publicImplementation.noCredentialPolicy: User has no partner JWT. Public-only investigation; no authenticated Explorer ingestion, access bypass or private data use.
publicImplementation.knownCeiling: Latest-unmatched-route greedy matching diagnoses a bounded subset of public reverse patterns, not exhaustive cycle detection. No count or volume is removed based on the heuristic.

publicSqlDiagnostic.canonicalScope: Same conservative 30-day public account-side event subset as SQL02. Repeated raw keys and hashes withheld, including valid repeated hashes; DECIMAL(38,0) is narrower than full signed i128.
publicSqlDiagnostic.method: Adjacent simple-pair events per account, ordered by block timestamp then physical event key. Reverse exact token IDs and both raw quantity legs must agree within 1% or 5%, within 15/60/240 minutes. Equal-timestamp events do not qualify.
publicSqlDiagnostic.accounting: Each event row counted once per scenario if its preceding or following pair qualifies. Pair matches can overlap while distinct event counts do not. All retained events remain; behavioral exclusions always zero.
publicSqlDiagnostic.differencesFromJs: Local JS diagnoses latest unmatched reverse-route events and matches returned initial-asset amount only; SQL diagnoses strictly adjacent simple pairs and requires both leg quantities. Results are not asserted equivalent.
publicSqlDiagnostic.limits: Not exhaustive cycle/ownership inference; first observation has no prior-window buffer; multiasset events excluded from adjacent simple sequence; public-only coverage, provider source lag, approximate double quantity comparisons and no USD volume removal.
